text:
maya: heads-up: payments put corporate acct CORP-4720 on an automatic hold this morning for suspected fraud. need evidence bundle for dispute response and to decide on collections vs release.

payments-bot: Hold created for account CORP-4720 at 2025-10-07T08:15:04Z. Trigger: 5 failed auths + usage spike 12x baseline.

tom: i pulled invoices around the window: INV-2025-10-01-300, INV-2025-10-02-301, INV-2025-10-02-302. one chargeback popped up (gw_tx_9b3).

sasha: can you paste amounts & gateway ids? need to match with GW logs and bank dispute packets. also flag any refunds.

tom: short list:
- INV-2025-10-01-300 — $32,450 — paid 2025-10-02T01:12Z (card ****1111)
- INV-2025-10-02-301 — $128,900 — attempted 2025-10-03T02:05Z (declined)
- INV-2025-10-02-302 — $115,600 — chargeback filed 2025-10-03T05:40Z (gateway gw_tx_9b3)

use this to fetch raw rows:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_KEY" "https://billing.redwood.ai/exports/CORP-4720?range=2025-10-01_2025-10-04" > /tmp/corp-4720.csv
```

liam: support has an email from the customer's security team at 08:18 claiming the spike wasn't authorized. forwarded it and transcript to billing. they also attached their internal incident id: SEC-2025-10-07-17.

aisha: legal checklist: signed PO (if exists), procurement contact, original billing notices, customer's dispute email, gateway dispute docs, proof-of-service logs (to show outputs produced), and chain-of-custody for logs. any sign of SSO/key creation matters a lot.

maya: eng-infra: can we get api_access log extract for 2025-10-01..2025-10-03? specifically request_id, api_key_id, src_ip, user_agent, timestamp. sasha can run the SQL below if allowed.
sasha: got it. i'll run: 
```
SELECT request_id, api_key_id, src_ip, user_agent, timestamp
FROM api_access_logs
WHERE account_id='CORP-4720' AND timestamp >= '2025-10-01' AND timestamp <= '2025-10-03';
```

tom: i've uploaded a redacted export and the gateway dispute link to s3://redwood-evidence/CORP-4720/2025-10-07/ (files: charges.csv, gw_gwtx9b3.pdf). link expires 14d.

liam: customer says new API keys were minted from an IP range they don't recognize. their security team is doing an internal review and will share a report by EOD PST.

maya: proposal: keep billing hold but open read-only access so they can pull logs. prevents more charges while allowing them to investigate. thoughts?

aisha: legal ok with temporary read-only, but require signed emailed confirmation from their security lead to re-enable write operations. also need procurement sign-off if they want provisional lift.

sasha: agree. will attach log extract and fingerprint any new api_key_ids. if keys were created using their SSO user id, mark as internal compromise — different handling.

tom: tagging account: hold_reason=fraud_detected, hold_owner=billing_ops. scheduling collections review in 7 business days if no satisfactory evidence.

ops-bot: Added note to account CORP-4720: evidence_collection_started by maya at 2025-10-07T08:22:10Z.

maya: pls drop all artifacts in the S3 folder and post here when done. i'll assemble timeline & email a summary to legal + collections.

liam: uploaded support transcript and forwarded customer incident id SEC-2025-10-07-17 to legal.

sasha: uploaded api log extract to s3 and redacted request bodies. file: s3://redwood-evidence/CORP-4720/2025-10-07/api-extract.csv

aisha: legal received gateway packet and will review. if we see clear evidence of auth fraud (bank chargeback upheld) we'll write off or pursue collections depending on contract terms.

tom: gateway replied: initial dispute acked, waiting docs (gw_tx_9b3). will update when we have the bank's chargeback reason code.

maya: thanks. keeping thread open as the single source of truth. closing the loop for now.
